events.text: Franciscan fathers founded Mission San Miguel Arcángel

evidence.quote: It was established on July 25 , 1797 by the Franciscan order
Father Fermín Lasuén and Father Buenaventura Sitjar founded the mission on July 25 , 1797

events.text: Small original chapel replaced by a new chapel
